speaker: Mr Darryl David
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry whether the Ministry has plans to help small and medium enterprises which may be adversely affected by significantly increased fuel and energy costs due to the conflict in Ukraine.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: To enable businesses to continue to upgrade themselves, we have enhanced the SkillsFuture Enterprise Credit and expanded the range of solutions under the Productivity Solutions Grant.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: We are prepared to put in place further measures to safeguard our energy security and assist affected businesses, as well as employees and staff alike, should there be a need to.

speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.
